cues.en: Ferry services between Eastport and Green Island were suspended on Tuesday morning.
cues.zh: 东港与格林岛之间的渡轮服务于周二上午暂停。

cues.en: The port authority said a fault was found during a routine safety check.
cues.zh: 港务局表示，在例行安全检查中发现了一处故障。

cues.en: It expects to resume service at six tomorrow morning, if the repairs pass a final inspection.
cues.zh: 如果维修通过最终检查，港务局预计明早六点恢复服务。

cues.en: Until then, passengers can use a free bus that leaves the ferry terminal every thirty minutes.
cues.zh: 在此之前，乘客可以搭乘每三十分钟从渡轮码头发车的免费巴士。

cues.en: Anyone who has already bought a ferry ticket can request a full refund online.
cues.zh: 已经买了船票的人可以在网上申请全额退款。

questions.prompt: Why were ferry services suspended?
questions.explanation: fault 在这里指设备故障。题目问暂停原因，后文的免费巴士是临时措施。
options: A storm damaged the bus terminal.
The port authority changed the route.
A mechanical fault was found.
The morning ferries were fully booked.

questions.prompt: What can passengers do while services are suspended?
questions.explanation: 选项里的 replacement bus 对应原文的 free bus。every thirty minutes 是班次频率。
options: Board a ferry from another terminal.
Use their tickets on an evening train.
Collect a refund only at the port.
Take a free replacement bus.

cues.en: W: Hi, can I book a study room for my group on Thursday afternoon?
cues.zh: 您好，我能给我们小组订一间周四下午的自习室吗？

cues.en: M: Thursday is nearly full. I have a room at four, but it only seats four people.
cues.zh: 周四几乎订满了。四点有一间，但只能坐四个人。

cues.en: W: There are six of us. Would Friday be easier?
cues.zh: 我们有六个人。周五会好订些吗？

cues.en: M: Yes. The large room is available at half past three on Friday.
cues.zh: 是的。大房间周五三点半有空。

cues.en: W: Great, that gives us time to go over our slides before the weekend.
cues.zh: 太好了，这样我们周末之前还有时间过一遍幻灯片。

cues.en: M: I'll reserve it for you. Please bring your student card to the front desk.
cues.zh: 我帮你预订。请带学生证到前台。

questions.prompt: Why does the woman turn down the Thursday room?
questions.explanation: seat 作动词表示容纳。她们一共有六人，周四的房间只有四个座位。
options: She has a class at four.
It is more expensive.
It cannot seat the whole group.
It has no projector.

questions.prompt: What should the woman bring to the front desk?
questions.explanation: 最后一句直接交代了到前台需要带的证件。
options: A copy of her slides.
A printed payment slip.
A student card.
A group attendance list.

cues.en: At a repair café, people bring broken household items and try to fix them with volunteers.
cues.zh: 在维修咖啡馆，人们带来损坏的家用物品，在志愿者的帮助下尝试修好它们。

cues.en: One Saturday, I took in a lamp that had stopped working.
cues.zh: 一个星期六，我带去了一盏坏掉的台灯。

cues.en: Instead of taking the lamp away, the volunteer showed me how to check the plug safely.
cues.zh: 志愿者没有把台灯拿走，而是教我怎样安全检查插头。

cues.en: I left with a working lamp and a better idea of how it was put together.
cues.zh: 离开时，台灯已经能用了，我也更了解它是怎样组装的。

cues.en: The café's aim is to cut waste and give visitors the confidence to try small repairs themselves.
cues.zh: 这家咖啡馆希望减少浪费，并让来访者更有信心自己做些小维修。

questions.prompt: What did the volunteer do with the lamp?
questions.explanation: instead of 对比了没有做的事和实际做的事，重点在后半句。
options: Took the lamp home to repair it.
Suggested throwing it away.
Showed the speaker how to check its plug.
Replaced it with a new lamp.

questions.prompt: What is one aim of the repair café?
questions.explanation: 选项改写了 give visitors the confidence to try small repairs themselves。
options: To give away electrical appliances.
To sell tools to volunteers.
To train people to be professional electricians.
To help people feel confident making small repairs.

cues.en: W: The internship coordinator offered me a three-month placement in May.
cues.zh: 实习协调员给我提供了一个从五月开始、为期三个月的岗位。

cues.en: M: Wasn't your dissertation due toward the end of June?
cues.zh: 你的论文不是六月底左右要交吗？

cues.en: W: Yes. I can handle both, provided the employer lets me work remotely on Fridays.
cues.zh: 是的。只要雇主允许我每周五远程办公，我就能兼顾。

cues.en: M: Then I would ask before accepting. Once you commit, it is harder to renegotiate your schedule.
cues.zh: 那我建议你接受前先问清楚。一旦承诺了，就很难重新协商日程。

cues.en: W: Good point. If they turn it down, I'll ask whether I can postpone the start date until July.
cues.zh: 有道理。如果他们不同意，我会问能不能把开始日期推迟到七月。

questions.prompt: Under what condition can the woman meet both commitments?
questions.explanation: provided 相当于 only if。远程办公是她判断能兼顾两件事的前提。
options: She receives a different assignment.
She can work remotely on Fridays.
She can finish her dissertation in May.
The internship is reduced to three weeks.

questions.prompt: What will she do if her request is refused?
questions.explanation: If they turn it down 对应题干的条件，postpone the start date 对应 later start date。
options: Request a different dissertation topic.
Move to another office.
Ask for a later start date.
Turn down the internship immediately.

title: Why cities underestimate night buses
zh: 城市夜间公交为何容易被低估

cues.en: A city was considering whether to cut a little-used night bus route.
cues.zh: 一座城市正在考虑是否取消一条乘客不多的夜班公交线路。

cues.en: Its initial analysis counted only tickets sold, which made the route appear inefficient.
cues.zh: 最初的分析只统计售出票数，因此这条线路看起来效益不高。

cues.en: Researchers asked passengers why they used the bus, and many said it was their only affordable way home after late shifts.
cues.zh: 研究人员询问乘客为什么坐这趟车，许多人说下了夜班后，只有这种方式回家负担得起。

cues.en: The researchers argued that a service could have low ridership and still make an important contribution to access to work.
cues.zh: 研究人员认为，一项服务即使客流低，仍可能对人们能否上班有重要作用。

cues.en: The city retained the route and added connections to two nearby hospitals.
cues.zh: 市政府保留了线路，还增设了到两家附近医院的换乘衔接。

questions.prompt: What did the initial analysis fail to consider?
questions.explanation: 最初只数了票，后续访谈才发现夜班乘客没有负担得起的替代方案。
options: How much the city charged researchers.
Why the passengers relied on the bus.
How many tickets were sold.
Which two hospitals had larger budgets.

questions.prompt: What change did the city make?
questions.explanation: retained 对应 kept，added connections 对应 improved connections。
options: It increased the price of a night ticket.
It moved the hospitals closer to the route.
It kept the route and improved connections.
It cut all night bus services.

cues.en: In a recent experiment, participants read the same article under two conditions.
cues.zh: 在一项近期实验中，参与者在两种条件下阅读同一篇文章。

cues.en: In the first condition, they heard a short notification sound every few minutes.
cues.zh: 在第一种条件下，他们每隔几分钟就听到一声短促的通知提示音。

cues.en: In the second, the room was quiet. Participants were not allowed to use a phone in either condition.
cues.zh: 第二种条件下，房间很安静。在两种条件下，参与者都不能使用手机。

cues.en: Those who heard notifications answered fewer questions about the main argument correctly.
cues.zh: 听到提示音的人在回答有关文章主要论点的问题时，正确率更低。

cues.en: The results suggest that a familiar sound can redirect attention even when people do not act on it.
cues.zh: 结果表明，熟悉的声音即使没有引发实际动作，也可能让人分心。

cues.en: The researchers caution that the study does not show how lasting that effect is.
cues.zh: 研究人员提醒，这项研究无法说明这种影响能持续多久。

questions.prompt: What was the key difference between the two conditions?
questions.explanation: 两组都读同一篇文章，也都不能使用手机。变量是有没有提示音。
options: Whether participants were allowed to use their phones.
Which article participants had to read.
How many participants answered questions.
Whether participants heard notifications.

questions.prompt: What limitation does the speaker mention?
questions.explanation: how lasting that effect is 对应 duration of the effect。caution 提示研究限制。
options: The article was different for each participant.
The sound could not be heard clearly.
The duration of the effect remains unclear.
The participants did not understand the instructions.

cues.en: W: Good morning, Riverside Arts Centre. How can I help?
cues.zh: 早上好，这里是河畔艺术中心。请问有什么可以帮您？

cues.en: M: I'd like to book a place on the Saturday pottery course.
cues.zh: 我想报名周六的陶艺课。

cues.en: W: Certainly. May I have your surname?
cues.zh: 当然。请问您姓什么？

cues.en: M: It's Fielding. That's F, I, E, L, D, I, N, G.
cues.zh: Fielding，拼作 F、I、E、L、D、I、N、G。

cues.en: W: Thank you. We used to charge fifty pounds, but the fee is now forty-five pounds.
cues.zh: 谢谢。原先收费五十英镑，现在是四十五英镑。

cues.en: M: Do I need to bring anything with me?
cues.zh: 我需要带什么吗？

cues.en: W: Yes, bring a notebook. We provide aprons and all the other materials.
cues.zh: 需要带笔记本。围裙和其他材料都由我们提供。

questions.prompt: Surname: ______
questions.explanation: 报名场景先判断空格需要的是姓氏，再按说话人逐个拼写的字母作答。

questions.prompt: Current course fee in pounds: ______
questions.explanation: used to 是过去，but 后面的 now 才是当前价格。

questions.prompt: Bring a ______.
questions.explanation: 题目问自己要带什么，provided 的 aprons 是主办方提供的。

cues.en: Welcome to Northbank Wetlands. Your map shows the entrance at the bottom of the page.
cues.zh: 欢迎来到北岸湿地。地图上方位以页面底部的入口为起点。

cues.en: From the entrance, follow the main path until it splits in two.
cues.zh: 从入口沿主路走，直到路分成两条。

cues.en: The observation tower is on the left-hand path, just past the wooden bridge.
cues.zh: 观鸟塔在左边那条路上，走过木桥就是。

cues.en: If you take the right-hand path, you will reach the visitor centre, where the afternoon talk takes place.
cues.zh: 走右边那条路则会到游客中心，下午的讲座在那里举行。

cues.en: Please stay on the marked paths; the ground next to the river is still soft after last night's rain.
cues.zh: 请沿有标记的道路行走。昨夜下雨，河边土壤仍然松软。

questions.prompt: Where is the observation tower?
questions.explanation: 先抓路径 left-hand path，然后定位 just past the wooden bridge。
options: At the entrance to the park.
Inside the visitor centre.
At the end of the right-hand path.
Just past the wooden bridge on the left-hand path.

questions.prompt: Where does the afternoon talk take place?
questions.explanation: where 引出的从句补充活动地点，先听到的 observation tower 是干扰项。
options: At the park entrance.
At the visitor centre.
At the observation tower.
On the wooden bridge.

title: Planning a visitor survey
zh: 小组研究中如何调查游客

cues.en: W: For our museum project, should we interview visitors at the entrance?
cues.zh: 为了我们的博物馆项目，我们应该在入口处采访访客吗？

cues.en: M: At the exit would be better. People can tell us about their whole visit then.
cues.zh: 出口会更好。那时人们能告诉我们整次参观的感受。

cues.en: W: Good point. We could also include a question about how they found out about the exhibition.
cues.zh: 有道理。我们还可以问他们是怎样了解到这场展览的。

cues.en: M: Agreed. I can draft the questionnaire today if you check the wording tomorrow.
cues.zh: 同意。我今天可以起草问卷，你明天帮我检查措辞。

cues.en: W: Let's try it with five visitors before we print the final version.
cues.zh: 在印最终版前，我们先找五位访客试填。

questions.prompt: What location do the students agree on for the interviews?
questions.explanation: 入口只是最初提议，better 后的出口被另一人认可。
options: The café.
The exhibition hall.
The exit.
The entrance.

questions.prompt: They will test the questionnaire with ______ visitors.
questions.explanation: 题干限定试测人数。听到 final version 前的 five visitors。

title: The cooling effects of street trees

cues.en: Today we will look at how street trees help to cool urban areas.
cues.zh: 今天我们会看行道树如何给城区降温。

cues.en: One obvious mechanism is shade, which keeps surfaces such as pavement from absorbing as much heat.
cues.zh: 一个明显的机制是遮阴，它让路面等表面少吸收一些热量。

cues.en: A second process involves water. Leaves release water vapour, which can cool the surrounding air.
cues.zh: 第二个过程与水有关。叶片释放水蒸气，可以让周围空气降温。

cues.en: In one project, researchers placed sensors both beneath trees and on an open street nearby.
cues.zh: 在一个项目中，研究人员在树下和附近空旷的一条街上都放置了传感器。

cues.en: The greatest temperature difference was seen in the afternoon, when the sun was strongest on the exposed street.
cues.zh: 下午温差最大，那时无遮挡街道受到的日照最强。

questions.prompt: The first cooling mechanism discussed is ______.
questions.explanation: 题干要填第一个机制，pavement 是被遮住的物体。

questions.prompt: Researchers used ______ to compare locations.
questions.explanation: placed sensors 是测量手段，树下和街道是对比地点。

questions.prompt: The biggest difference was in the ______.
questions.explanation: greatest temperature difference 对应 biggest difference，答案是时间。
